name: City of Pacific Grove News
notes: 6 items (newest: Storm Preparedness meeting 10/7, so current). Revize CMS: titles + links only, no pubDate/description/images, so stamp fetch time and use the headline as summary. Item links use the old .org domain, which redirects to .gov. Site has a copyright notice but no limits on linking; public government info. Fetch: links normalized .org -> .gov; date = first-seen time; summary = headline; no og lookup. Returns 403 to the default bot UA from GitHub Actions; fetched with a browser-like UA + Accept headers (user_agent: "browser").

name: BigSurKate (Kate Woods Novoa)
notes: 10 items, latest 2026-10-06. Independent community blog by Kate Woods Novoa covering Big Sur, Hwy 1 status, fires. Description is only the WordPress 'The post X appeared first on BigSurKate' line, so strip it and fall back to the headline. No media in feed; og:image on pages. Terms (site footer): excerpts and links allowed with full, clear credit to Kate Woods Novoa/BigSurKate and a direct link. Credit as 'BigSurKate (Kate Woods Novoa)'. Fetch: source name carries the required credit; summary = headline (feed description is filler).
